notes.title: Backroads content update out now
notes.notes:
[b]The content update for Decimate Drive, the indie horror game in which killer cars are out for blood, is out now! It's a free update featuring a new story mode, new killer cars and much more.[/b]

[previewyoutube=XhLo6r8gZRU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Backroads[/h3]

The new (short) story mode is set in a remote backcountry where killer cars rely on heavy for to remain unseen. It features six new locations and six new killer cars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/253d946f5068127a5db6062f04c96804a60ef774.png[/img]
[h3]Killer car gallery[/h3]

This content update also adds a gallery so you can view all killer cars and some important objects from the story. Finding collectibles will unlock more of the gallery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/75db85d3868db2e1fb89c2fb8e8142794ac2215a.png[/img]
[h3]Much more[/h3]

- New dash ability to dodge enemies at the last second.
- New crouch ability to take routes where enemies can't follow you.
- Additional cinematics for the main story line.
- Improvements to the Hit & Run arcade mode.
- Tweaks to make unfair kills less likely.
- Other small improvements and bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/63c52dff418e42f66c4a106d84a5ca5602f2a16d.png[/img]
The content update is now available, so check it out!

notes.title: Quick progress update
notes.notes:
This weeks update of Decimate Drive, a game set in a killer car infested city, is about the release plans and latest progress.

[h3]The plan[/h3]

If all goes well, the full release (including a complete story, new game + and a wide range of levels and enemies) of Decimate Drive will be early 2024. At first I had an Early Access release in mind. Because completing the story and adding additional gameplay elements took less time than expected, I have decided to skip it and go straight to a full release.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/fa4e1bfee3c2104abe3dd900f6d155d81192dc73.png[/img]

Despite skipping Early Access, I expect to add more stuff to the game after its release. It's a project I work on in my spare time though. So I don't really know how much time I'll have and what I can pull off. Hopefully things like other story lines, different settings etc. But no promises!

[h3]Finishing touches[/h3]

I'm currently finishing up the last couple of levels, completing the story and, most important of all, hunting for bugs. December is going to be a busy month for me however, so it might be a bit quiet in terms of devlogs and updates. Just know that behind the scenes things are happening 😁


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/8bcd67eb2b86fd71a2b93db5419fc8cb391ac542.png[/img]

notes.title: Playtest and progress update
notes.notes:
This weeks devlog is about the playtest (still regularly updated) and the upcoming early access release of Decimate Drive.

[h3]About the playtest[/h3]
Since starting the playtest, the game has gone through several updates based on the feedback you provided. From tweaks to the difficulty to smoother movement. Thanks again for taking the time to help out!

Improvements to the damage done by cars are still a work in progress, but will probably make their way into the next playtest version.

Join [url=https://discord.com/channels/1113374677839126528]Discord[/url] to find out how to start playtesting. Go to the #playtest channel after joining Discord for more info.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/377f81c8401dca1d664e6eb6c92febb12f38eb61.png[/img]

[h3]Next stop, early access[/h3]
From now on I’ll be working towards an early access release. This means finishing the story (I didn’t include it in the playtest so as not to spoil the plot), adding more vehicles and adding more levels.

Something I also want to work on is the way cars behave. As some of you also suggeted, it would be interesting to see each car behave in a unique way. There’s a little of that in the playtest already, but there are tons of options the game doesn’t explore yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/7a02a37910e638ddcd0efff991e9459bc8090670.png[/img]
